content.title: Dhurandhar 2 Release: Check Runtime, Cast, Pre-Booking, Release Languages, Countries, Cameos, Paid Preview Collection, Expected Box Office Collection & All You Need to Know
content.text: The excitement for Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge is reaching new heights as fans gear up for its global release on March 19, 2026. The sequel to the blockbuster Dhurandhar promises a high-octane mix of action, drama, and espionage that keeps audiences on the edge of their seats. Bookings have already broken records, signalling a potential record-setting opening both in India and overseas. With an ensemble cast led by Ranveer Singh, the film features star-studded performances, intriguing cameos, and a storyline that expands the Dhurandhar universe. Dhurandhar 2 Release Date Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge is confirmed to arrive in theatres on 19 March 2026, lining up with festive occasions like Gudi Padwa, Ugadi and Eid al‑Fitr to draw in larger audiences. The makers have planned paid preview shows from the evening of March 18 to build early box‑office momentum ahead of the official release. You Might Be Interested In This global theatrical launch marks a strategic move after the massive success of the first Dhurandhar film. Fans have also seen the original movie re‑released in cinemas shortly before the sequel’s coming out to heighten anticipation. Dhurandhar 2 Runtime Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge is confirmed to be one of the longest Indian films released in recent years, with a runtime of approximately 235 minutes — that’s nearly 3 hours and 55 minutes on screen. The film has received an ‘A’ (Adult) certificate, and its runtime includes intense action, dramatic sequences and plot expansions that go beyond typical commercial films. Despite its length, the anticipation and bookings remain strong, indicating that audiences are ready to embrace the epic cinematic experience. Dhurandhar 2 Advance Booking Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge has set off a whirlwind of bookings well ahead of its theatrical launch on 19 March 2026. The spy thriller has already sold over 10 lakh tickets for opening day shows, generating more than ₹50 crore in revenue from advance sales alone. Early data shows that more than 12.64 lakh tickets have been booked across India, spread over 26,761 shows, and the film has raked in ₹40.58 crore even before its official release date. Paid previews and first‑day bookings caught the attention of exhibitors, with many multiplexes—even in cities like Mumbai, Pune and Ahmedabad—adding midnight and 24‑hour screenings to meet the growing demand. Reports also indicate that advance sales have crossed ₹130 crore worldwide and approximately 15 lakh tickets across India and overseas markets. Dhurandhar 2 Cast Here is the web‑verified cast ensemble for Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge, featuring returning stars and key supporting players in Aditya Dhar’s spy thriller: Ranveer Singh — Lead protagonist returning in the central role. Sanjay Dutt — Reprising his character from the original film. Arjun Rampal — Back as part of the core team. R. Madhavan — Plays a key strategist role. Sara Arjun — Continues her role from the first instalment. Rakesh Bedi — Returns with his character from the original story. Manav Gohil — Part of the returning cast. Danish Pandor — Reprises his role. Saumya Tandon — Featured in a key supporting part. Gaurav Gera — Returns with his character from Dhurandhar. Naveen Kaushik — Included in the ensemble. Additional reported cast buzz: Industry updates also suggest Yami Gautam may make a notable appearance in the sequel, adding another strong screen presence, though her exact role is speculated and not officially confirmed. Dhurandhar 2 Release Languages To broaden its market impact, the film will be released in five languages — Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam. This pan‑India strategy aims to replicate and exceed the first film’s nationwide performance. Dhurandhar 2 Release in Which Countries India – All major cities and regions United States – Including New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, San Francisco United Kingdom – London, Birmingham, Manchester Australia – Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane Canada – Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal New Zealand – Auckland, Wellington Singapore – Key multiplexes Malaysia – Kuala Lumpur and Penang Europe (selected countries) – Germany, France, Netherlands Note: The film may not be released in some Middle Eastern countries, such as Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, and Qatar, due to previous censorship issues. Dhurandhar 2 Cameos Yami Gautam is widely reported to be making a special cameo appearance in Dhurandhar 2. She is expected to appear in a hospital‑set scene, adding intrigue and potentially linking Dhurandhar 2 to Aditya Dhar’s larger spy universe. Multiple news outlets highlight that Yami’s cameo has generated buzz among fans as a pivotal moment in the film, even if it’s brief. Rumours and fan theories are circulating online about other surprise cameos, including speculative names like Salman Khan or Vicky Kaushal, but there is no official confirmation from the makers about them. Veteran actor Anil Kapoor revealed he was offered a cameo in the film but declined due to prior commitments, expressing that dropping other work would be unprofessional. Dhurandhar 2 Censor Certificate Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge has officially received an ‘A’ (Adults Only) certificate from the film censor board ahead of its theatrical release on 19 March 2026. The A certificate indicates that the movie is rated for adult audiences due to strong violence, intense action and mature themes. The official certification comes along with the confirmation of the film’s final runtime, which is nearly 3 hours and 52 minutes, making it one of the lengthier Indian releases. Media reports noted that the A certificate was granted by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC), reflecting the film’s content and suitability for adult viewers. Dhurandhar 2 Trailer The official trailer for Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge was released digitally on 7 March 2026, giving fans a first look at Ranveer Singh in intense, high‑octane sequences that set up the film’s larger narrative and emotional stakes. The trailer has already racked up tens of millions of views on YouTube, making it one of the most talked‑about Bollywood promos this year. In the clip, Ranveer’s character Hamza appears in raw “beast mode,” showcasing dramatic confrontations and high drama that hint at the sequel’s expansive storyline.Multiple reactions on social media, from fans to fellow celebrities, point to the trailer’s 3 min 25 sec runtime and its striking visuals as major highlights. Dhurandhar 2 Budget Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge comes with a very high production budget, placing it among the costliest projects in recent Bollywood history. According to industry reporting and film data, the combined budget for Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar 2 is estimated at around ₹250–₹475 crore, with a significant portion allocated to this second part as well. This expansive budget reflects the film’s large‑scale action sequences, extensive locations, technical production design, visual effects, and the star‑studded cast led by Ranveer Singh and other major names. Dhurandhar 2 Cast Education Qualification Here’s a quick look at the educational qualifications of the main cast members of Dhurandhar 2, offering insights into their academic journeys before film careers: Ranveer Singh — Completed schooling at Learner’s Academy (ICSE), Mumbai; attended H.R. College of Commerce & Economics; earned a Bachelor of Arts from Indiana University, USA. Sanjay Dutt — Schooled at The Lawrence School, Sanawar; attended Elphinstone College but left to pursue acting. Akshaye Khanna — Studied at Bombay International School and Lawrence School (Ooty); graduated from H.R. College; trained at Kishore Namit Kapoor Acting Institute. Arjun Rampal — Schooled at Kodaikanal International School; graduated from Hindu College, Delhi with Economics; later moved to modelling and films. R. Madhavan — Holds a B.Sc. in Electronics; trained in England and completed a postgraduate course in Public Speaking. Rakesh Bedi — Studied at Kendriya Vidyalaya, Delhi; trained at the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII), Pune. Sara Arjun — Currently pursuing studies in Performing Arts and Film Studies alongside acting. Dhurandhar Cast Fees Reports based on industry insights and recent data on Bollywood cast remunerations indicate the significant paychecks for stars in Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge: Ranveer Singh — Highest fee, around ₹50 crore for the sequel, reflecting his lead status. Sanjay Dutt — Approximately ₹10 crore. R. Madhavan — Around ₹9 crore. Akshaye Khanna — Reportedly ₹2.5 crore for his role. Arjun Rampal — About ₹1 crore. Sara Arjun — Around ₹1 crore. These figures highlight the rising stakes of major franchise films in Bollywood, where leading talent commands strong compensation packages. Dhurandhar 2 Box Office Prediction Industry analysts are forecasting a massive box office opening for Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge ahead of its theatrical release on 19 March 2026. With record‑breaking bookings and strong fan anticipation, many experts believe the film could surpass ₹150–₹200 crore on opening day worldwide, making it one of the biggest Bollywood openings of the year. Several predictions also suggest that the sequel could achieve ₹500 crore or more over its first weekend, driven by pan‑India releases in multiple languages and strong overseas interest. Dhurandhar 2 Paid Preview Collection Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge has already set new benchmarks with its paid preview collections even before the official release on 19 March 2026, with many trade reports highlighting blockbuster‑level numbers. Early data shows the film has earned around ₹15.6 crore from paid previews alone, with block bookings pushing the total preview‑related revenue to about ₹21.19 crore nationally. Some box office trackers project that as more shows sell out, the paid preview total could cross ₹30–₹35 crore before the official opening day. Reports also note that the film is already surpassing previous paid preview records, with the Hindi version contributing the largest share of the preview collection so far. Dhurandhar 2 Review Early reviews for Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge are beginning to surface ahead of wider critic screenings, and the initial buzz paints the film as a high‑impact action spectacle with strong audience anticipation. Some early reviewers describe the sequel as “will leave you speechless,” highlighting Ranveer Singh’s intense performance and the film’s dramatic visuals that aim to push the franchise further. Industry insiders like Yami Gautam have publicly praised the sequel, calling it “beyond extraordinary” after watching a preview screening, suggesting that the film delivers on its emotional and cinematic promise. The response to promotional materials, especially the trailer, also indicates strong excitement, with many fans and commentators noting the gritty tone and larger scale compared to the first instalment. While broad critic reviews are still limited due to the film’s upcoming release on 19 March 2026, early reactions focus on its action sequences and Ranveer Singh’s screen presence, hinting that Dhurandhar 2 could be both a visual treat and a solid continuation of the franchise’s narrative arc. Dhurandhar 2 Opening Prediction Trade analysts and box office trackers are projecting a meteoric opening for Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge when it hits cinemas on 19 March 2026, driven by record‑setting advance sales and buzz around the sequel. Some forecasts suggest the film could achieve a ₹200 crore worldwide gross on its opening day, placing it among the biggest Bollywood openings this year. Weekend predictions are even more bullish, with ₹500 crore or more over the first three days expected by major trade observers, powered by strong pan‑India release and overseas shows. Early booking data hints that opening collections in India alone might reach ₹100‑₹130 crore, including paid previews, reflecting unprecedented viewer demand. Some industry forecasts even compare the sequel’s potential with blockbuster films like Jawan, Animal and KGF 2, saying it could challenge the highest‑grossing Indian films of all time if momentum continues through the weekend. Dhurandhar 2 Pre Booking Collection Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge has smashed pre‑booking records with tickets sold well ahead of its theatrical release on March 19, 2026. Across India, the film has seen over 12.64 lakh tickets booked in advance, with 26,761 shows already scheduled prior to release. Pre‑release collections from bookings and paid previews have crossed ₹40.58 crore in India, even before the main release day. Broader reports indicate worldwide booking revenue exceeding ₹120–₹130 crore, combining domestic and overseas ticket sales. Some estimates earlier noted the film had already earned ₹56 crore globally from pre‑sales shortly after bookings opened. Strong advance numbers suggest Dhurandhar 2 is on track for a huge opening weekend and potential box office records. Dhurandhar Box Office Collection (Predicted) The original Dhurandhar starring Ranveer Singh became one of the highest‑grossing Indian films of 2025, crossing the ₹1,000 crore worldwide mark early in its theatrical run. Within its first 21 days in cinemas, the film grossed over ₹650 crore in India alone and ended up with a total global box office of around ₹1,006.7 crore. As the film continued its run into January 2026, Dhurandhar further increased its earnings, with some reports estimating worldwide gross totals even higher — more than ₹1,200 crore by day 34. It set multiple records domestically, becoming the highest‑earning Hindi film at the Indian box office, surpassing previous hits like Pushpa 2. Dhurandhar also stood out internationally, with strong overseas performance contributing significantly to its overall gross despite bans in some Middle Eastern markets. The blockbuster success of Dhurandhar laid a robust foundation for its sequel, Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge, which has generated huge anticipation and pre‑release buzz across global markets.
